original_evidence_b.quote_en: Eight primary screens each require one primary action and status summary. Draft labels use accessible `DRAFT`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, `PUBLISHED`, not color alone. Run refresh reconstructs server state; SSE increasing offsets reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`, replay retained caller-scoped history only.
